products.title: The Forever Can
products.story: Match the wallpaper. Change the paper. Keep the can.
products.description: Welcome to The FOREVER CAN — a fully customizable wastebasket by Patti Gilley. Transform it with wallpaper, art, personal photos, seasonal holiday paper, and more. Clear acrylic shell with a brushed-nickel stainless-steel insert and interchangeable décor. $59.95 on Etsy shop WallpaperWastebasket.
products.longDescription: This is the live listing: The Forever Can, Wallpaper Wastebasket, Decorative Trashcan, Custom DIY Trashcan, Designer Trashcan, ForeverCan. A beautifully designed, fully customizable wastebasket. Slip wallpaper, art, or photos behind the clear acrylic shell; the brushed-nickel stainless insert holds the look. When the room changes, the paper changes. Patented by Patti Gilley. In stock on Etsy, 5.0 from about 18 reviews, 30-day returns.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, brushed-nickel stainless-steel insert, interchangeable décor template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Brushed Nickel Insert
products.story: Cool stainless. The quiet metal that lets the paper speak.
products.description: The Forever Can with the brushed-nickel stainless-steel insert. Same clear acrylic shell and DIY template — choose nickel when you want the rim to read chrome, tile, and powder-room hardware.
products.longDescription: The listing offers a brushed-nickel stainless-steel or gold-finish insert. This storefront option is the nickel path: a cool metal liner that nests inside the acrylic shell and holds wallpaper, art, or photos in view. Checkout is the same Etsy listing from shop WallpaperWastebasket — pick the nickel finish there.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, brushed-nickel stainless-steel insert, DIY template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Gold-Finish Insert
products.story: Warm gold rim. Brass-adjacent, not costume.
products.description: The Forever Can with the gold-finish insert. Same acrylic shell and interchangeable décor — choose gold when the room already has warm metal, cane, or a little theater.
products.longDescription: The live Etsy listing specifies a brushed-nickel stainless-steel or gold-finish insert. This option is the gold path. The template photograph on the listing shows the gold rim with The Forever Can DIY instructions printed on the interchangeable insert. Checkout opens the same WallpaperWastebasket listing at $59.95.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, gold-finish insert, DIY template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Custom DIY Wallpaper
products.story: Leftover roll. Trace the template. Drop it in.
products.description: The DIY Forever Can: place the included template on your wallpaper, trace, cut, and drop it behind the acrylic. Match the powder room paper exactly — that is the point of the patent.
products.longDescription: The listing copy is the DIY brief: place the template on the front of your favorite wallpaper, art, or photo; trace with a pen; cut with scissors; overlap the ends; drop it into your Wallpaper Wastebasket. Finished. One can, your paper, $59.95 on Etsy.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, nickel or gold insert, cutting template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Art & Personal Photos
products.story: Not only wallpaper. Art, prints, family photos.
products.description: The Forever Can also wears art and personal photos. Print, trim to the template, and slip the montage behind the clear acrylic — a designer trashcan that is actually yours.
products.longDescription: Patti’s listing calls out wallpaper, art, personal photos, and more. This storefront option is the picture path: a photo strip, a favorite print, a kid’s drawing. Same $59.95 kit on Etsy shop WallpaperWastebasket. Same interchangeable décor. Nickel or gold insert at checkout.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, nickel or gold insert, photo/art template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Seasonal Holiday Paper
products.story: December paper in December. Spring paper in March.
products.description: The Forever Can is built for seasonal holiday paper. Swap wrapping paper, winter toile, or a spring floral without buying a new bin.
products.longDescription: The Etsy description names seasonal holiday paper as a first-class décor option. That is why the insert is interchangeable: one patented can, a new wrap when the calendar turns. Purchase is still the single WallpaperWastebasket listing at $59.95.
products.materials: Clear acrylic shell, nickel or gold insert, seasonal paper template
products.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.
